title: MECH ＆ THERMODYNAMICS OF PROPULSION
description: Principles of propulsion. Thermodynamic cycles of air breathing propulsion systems including ramjet, scramjet, turbojet, and turbofan engine and rocket propulsion system concepts. Turbine engine and rocket performance characteristics. Component and cycle analysis of jet engines and turbomachinery. Advanced propulsion systems. Columbia Engineering interdisciplinary course.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( MECE E3301 ) and ( MECE E4306 ) or instructor approval
